<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- PR 1 — branch: gdn-prefill-out-buffer (d385d46b18), base: main. -->

## Overview

Small optimizations for FlashInfer GDN prefill
- Replace `torch.zeros()` in GDN core attn output with `torch.empty()`
- FlashInfer GDN prefill writes directly to output buffer, eliminating memcpy
- Feed FlashInfer GDN prefill kernel `exp(g)` from the producer + use int32 `cu_seqlens` without cast.

## Claims

- Qwen3.8-27B: e2e TPOT c1 −1.9% on the #51012 base, −0.4..−0.7% on main.
- **GSM8K unchanged**: Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 0.865 → 0.862, Qwen3-Next-80B-NVFP4 0.8848 → 0.8893 (noise); and under the exact #28182 failure recipe (conc 250), no-zeroing 0.9287 vs zeroed 0.9204.

## Validation

### Microbenchmarks

`vllm bench forward` (graph-replayed, per-commit stages, sample spread ≤0.16%), Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B (18 GDN layers), one B300, FlashInfer 0.7.2.post1. Deltas are per commit, cumulative:

| stage | prefill 8192 | chunked prefill 2048@10240 | mix (64d + 4096 pre) | decode 256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| base (b7f0dda503) | 19100.7 µs | 7359.4 µs | 12886.0 µs | 8181.8 µs |
| +1 empty out | −191 µs | −77 µs | −98 µs | −21 µs |
| +2 in place | −163 µs | −17 µs | −135 µs | ~0 |
| +3 exp(g), cu | −53 µs | −95 µs | −58 µs | ~0 |
| **this PR** | **−2.2%** | **−2.6%** | **−2.3%** | **−0.2%** |

### E2E performance

`vllm serve <model> --max-model-len 16384`, default compile, random dataset, A B A B rounds on one GB300 GPU, development branch (this PR plus follow-on GDN prefill changes):

| metric | base (ms) | PR (ms) | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TTFT 8k c1, median of 4 rounds | 178.8 | 170.9 | −4.4% |
| TTFT 2k c1, median of 4 rounds | 173.0 | 161.1 | −6.9% |
| TPOT 1k/512 c1 | 5.464 | 5.438 | −0.5% |
| TPOT 1k/512 c16 | 6.750 | 6.706 | −0.6% |
| TPOT 1k/512 c64 | 11.191 | 11.398 | noise |
| TPOT 8k/1k c64 | 21.133 | 21.048 | −0.4% |

Base-vs-base noise on the same harness: ±2-3% (8k +2.1%, 2k −2.8% with identical code); single TTFT rounds move up to +20% under tray CPU load; TPOT repeats within ~1%. TTFT deltas are indicative, TPOT deltas are real but small. 

### Accuracy

GSM8K five-shot chat completions, temp 0, full test set (1319 questions):

| model / configuration | base flexible / strict | PR flexible / strict |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 (development branch) | 0.865 / — | 0.862 / — |
| Qwen3-Next-80B-NVFP4 (development branch) | 0.8848 / — | 0.8893 / — |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4, TP2, conc 250 (#28182 recipe) | 0.9204 / 0.9174 | 0.9287 / 0.9272 |

Unchanged within noise on all three. The conc-250 row runs the exact #28182 failure recipe — base there is the padding-rows-zeroed variant, PR is this PR's fully uninitialized buffer: no collapse, difference within run noise.

### Tests

- Route tests developed alongside this PR exercise its paths (NaN-poisoned buffers assert every actual row is written; in-place output placement; checkpointed prefills): **130 passed, 2 skipped** on GB300; related GDN/mamba files **391 passed, 2 skipped**; reproduced on B300 (43/43). They are not part of this diff; a trimmed version covering the actual-row and in-place invariants can be added here if reviewers want them pinned in this PR.
- `pytest tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_prefill_flashinfer.py` (cu_seqlens pass-through, checkpoint export) — pass; pre-commit (ruff, mypy) green on changed files.
- Compiled consistency (Qwen3.5-0.8B, compiled vs eager, fresh/chunked/prefix-hit/mixed/24-concurrent batches): base vs PR first-4-token logprobs differ ≤0.08, same as compiled-vs-eager within one arm.

AI assistance was used in the creation of this PR; the submitter reviewed every changed line and ran the validations above.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
